title: Density of States
description: Essential Criteria: The student must correctly derive the density of states D(p) and D(ε) as functions of momentum and energy.

title: Bose-Einstein Temperature
description: Essential Criteria: The student must accurately calculate the Bose-Einstein condensation temperature τ_E for arbitrary d.

title: Harmonic Potential Effect
description: Important Criteria: The student should explain how the external harmonic potential affects condensation and provide reasoning for their conclusion.

title: Integral Evaluation
description: Important Criteria: The student must correctly evaluate the integral involving the density of states to find the number of particles N_e.

title: Limiting Cases
description: Optional Criteria: The student should discuss cases where condensation does not occur, particularly for d = 1 and d = 2.

title: Final Answers
description: Essential Criteria: The student must provide the correct final expressions for D(p), D(ε), and τ_E.

title: Common Errors
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student should avoid common mistakes such as incorrect substitutions or miscalculating integrals.

title: Units Consistency
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student must ensure that all units are consistent throughout their calculations.
